text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I deliver a huge stack of fan letters to Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my, so many letters! I can totally feel everyone's support! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, I have some time right now. Can I read them?
choice_data_list: Of course, that's why I brought them.
Of course, that's why I brought them.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Okay, let me take a look…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "You burn up the track like a hot rod! You're the best!" Aww, how nice! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "I'm so looking forward to your next race!" Then I'll give you a run to remember!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm, what's this one say? "I love your singing, Maruzensky! You are my fire!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's like they're saying I'm their one desire! ♪ I'm so happy they enjoyed my concert!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew… I think that's everything. That was so much fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All of these letters are so full of emotion… It really makes me realize how much support I have.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I want to run not only for myself, but for everyone's enjoyment…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It really seems like my feelings are reaching people.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You think so too, don't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You think so too, don't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's why I'll kick it into high gear again for my next race.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'll be happy to run, sing, and dance… They'll fall even more head over heels for me!
